summary.en: S1-MAS assigns bounded coordination to a Laya controller and evidence retrieval to a small Qwen reader while reserving substantive reasoning for larger workers. Across seven benchmarks it reports improved accuracy with reduced worker-token consumption and end-to-end latency relative to three multi-agent baselines. It is included as a concrete open Jev-style coordination application, with savings reflecting the complete controller-reader-worker design and its stated execution budgets.
summary.zh: S1-MAS 将有限选项的协调决策交给 Laya 控制器，将证据检索交给小型 Qwen 阅读器，并把实质性推理留给更大的工作模型。在七个基准上，研究报告相较于三种多智能体基线，其准确率提高，工作模型的 token 消耗和端到端延迟降低。本文作为具体的开放 Jev 风格协调应用被收录，其节省来自完整的控制器、阅读器与工作模型设计，以及所设定的执行预算。

papers.title: Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge

summary.en: This controlled financial-verification study holds operands and arithmetic fixed while moving citations between source cells containing the same number. Jev both accepts some wrong-role citations and withholds some equivalent valid evidence; explicit column labels help selected cases without removing the tradeoff. It is included for isolating evidence-role recognition from numerical matching, with a separately reviewed follow-up on thirty-six new source pages.
summary.zh: 这项受控金融核验研究保持操作数和算术计算不变，只在数值相同的来源单元格之间交换引用。Jev 既会接受部分角色错误的引用，也会拒绝部分等价且有效的证据；显式列标签能改善一些案例，却未消除这种权衡。本文将证据角色识别与数值匹配分离，并在三十六个新来源页面上进行了单独复核的后续研究。

papers.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?

summary.en: BOTTLED tests whether LLM agents can turn an unlabeled workload into reusable low-cost programs or small models under fixed resource budgets. Most runs lose substantial quality relative to direct inference, but selected artifacts offer large amortized savings and a direct Jev comparison on query-product relevance. It is included as an alternative to repeated decision-model calls, with reported cost advantages depending on workload scale and retained accuracy.
summary.zh: BOTTLED 测试 LLM 智能体能否在固定资源预算下，将无标签工作负载转化为可复用、低成本的程序或小模型。多数运行相较直接推理损失了明显质量，但部分产物在分摊成本后能大幅节省开销，并在查询—商品相关性上提供了与 Jev 的直接比较。本文研究了反复调用决策模型之外的替代路径，所报告的成本优势依赖工作负载规模和保留的准确率。

papers.title: Emo-Jev: Probabilistic Reasoning for Emotion Classification with Jev

summary.en: Emo-Jev composes atomic Jev judgments or aggregates multiple judgment paths for sentiment, emotion, sarcasm, and humor classification. Across eight datasets, direct Jev classification offers low observed latency and cost but trails the strongest LLM's average macro-F1; neither proposed variant improves that average despite some dataset-level gains. It is included for testing whether additional probabilistic decomposition helps, with fixed question inventories and text-only tasks limiting generalization.
summary.zh: Emo-Jev 通过组合原子级 Jev 判断，或汇总多条判断路径，完成情感、情绪、讽刺和幽默分类。在八个数据集上，直接 Jev 分类的实测延迟与成本较低，但平均宏 F1 落后于最强 LLM；提出的两种变体虽在个别数据集上获益，却都未提高这一平均值。本文检验增加概率分解是否有用，固定的问题集合和纯文本任务限制了结论推广。

papers.title: From Probabilities to Decisions: Search and Multi-Teacher Distillation with Jev

summary.en: The authors distill Jev's pairwise judgments into compact evaluators for chess search and passage reranking, avoiding live model calls inside latency-sensitive loops. Under matched labeling budgets, combining Jev and Qwen teachers improves chess evaluation over Qwen alone, but adds little reranking quality beyond Jev labels. It is included for separating search, reusable distilled judgment, and teacher complementarity; the chess system also relies on Stockfish, an opening book, and tablebases.
summary.zh: 作者将 Jev 的成对判断蒸馏为用于国际象棋搜索和段落重排的紧凑评估器，避免在延迟敏感的循环中实时调用模型。在匹配的标注预算下，结合 Jev 与 Qwen 教师比仅用 Qwen 更能改善棋局评估，但相较于单独使用 Jev 标签，对重排质量的额外提升很小。本文区分了搜索、可复用的蒸馏判断和教师互补性，因此被收录；国际象棋系统还依赖 Stockfish、开局库与残局库。

papers.title: Visual Jev Rewards: Reference-Bound Verification for Multi-Subject Image Generation

summary.en: Visual Jev Rewards trains a Qwen3.5-4B verifier to score whether requested visual conditions hold for the specified reference subjects, then averages binary probabilities into a GRPO reward. A small image-generation training study improves a model-graded composite score on a selected 897-task subset. It is included as a Jev-style reward application, with one training run per reward and inconclusive human comparisons preventing a claim of established superiority.
summary.zh: Visual Jev Rewards 训练 Qwen3.5-4B 验证器，判断指定参考主体是否满足所要求的视觉条件，再将二元概率的平均值作为 GRPO 奖励。一项小规模图像生成训练研究在选定的 897 项任务子集上提高了由模型评分的综合指标。本文作为 Jev 风格的奖励应用被收录，但每种奖励仅进行一次训练，且人工比较尚无定论，因此不能认定其优势已经确立。

papers.title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?

summary.en: System Switch pairs open Jev-style decision actors with a reasoning vision-language model, escalating uncertain decisions while Doom continues running. On 900 held-out questions, confidence-based deferral improves over random deferral, but none of the variants reaches the exit across 33 closed-loop games. It is included for separating offline decision gains from agent progress; persistent plans help interaction, yet a fixed exploration rule matches much of the apparent benefit.
summary.zh: System Switch 将开放的 Jev 风格决策执行模型与推理型视觉语言模型配对，在 Doom 持续运行时将不确定决策升级处理。在 900 个留出问题上，基于置信度的转交优于随机转交，但所有变体在 33 场闭环游戏中均未到达出口。本文区分了离线决策改善与智能体任务进展，因此被收录；持续保留计划有助于交互，但固定探索规则也能取得大部分表面收益。

papers.title: NL2Hull: A Natural Language-Driven Constrained Ship Design Decision Framework

summary.en: NL2Hull maps natural-language ship-editing requests to typed action probabilities, executable free-form deformation, and geometric constraint checks. Its specialized Chip model is evaluated against Jev and language models on 43,496 questions and reports strong decision and action accuracy. It is included as a Jev-comparable engineering decision framework, while sequential edits expose constraint-composition failures and the interface does not yet predict continuous deformation magnitudes or spatial extents.
summary.zh: NL2Hull 将自然语言船体编辑请求映射为类型化动作概率、可执行的自由形式变形和几何约束检查。研究在 43,496 个问题上将专用 Chip 模型与 Jev 及语言模型比较，并报告较高的决策和动作准确率。本文作为可与 Jev 比较的工程决策框架被收录，但连续编辑暴露了约束组合失效，且接口尚不能预测连续的变形幅度或空间范围。

papers.title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift

summary.en: This study compares Jev, open language models, and a supervised model on 128 HVAC fault days from four real-equipment datasets, varying physical features, topology, and deployment conditions. Jev diagnoses faults supported by individual physical features but struggles when operating context is required; under shifts it is more stable than the supervised comparator. It is included as a bounded diagnostic application, with weak detection and probabilities requiring correction limiting autonomous use.
summary.zh: 这项研究使用四个真实设备数据集中的 128 个暖通空调故障日，比较 Jev、开放语言模型和监督模型，并改变物理特征、拓扑与部署条件。Jev 能诊断由单项物理特征支持的故障，但在需要运行背景时表现欠佳；发生分布偏移时，它比监督对照模型更稳定。本文作为有限选项诊断应用被收录，但较弱的检测能力和需要修正的概率限制了其自主使用。

papers.title: Estimating Uncoded Crash Factors with Tabular Foundation and System One Models: Kumo Tabular and Jev

summary.en: The authors combine Kumo Tabular predictions over 5.6 million Texas crash records, Jev readings of sampled narratives, and human recalibration to estimate factors missed by coded fields. A separate probability-sampled human check supports the reported population estimates, and targeted rereading finds substantially more discordance than random review. It is included as a Jev-assisted statistical workflow whose validity depends on sampling and human checks, measuring documented factors rather than underlying crash causation.
summary.zh: 作者将 Kumo Tabular 对 560 万条得克萨斯州交通事故记录的预测、Jev 对抽样叙述的解读以及人工再校准相结合，估计编码字段遗漏的因素。独立的概率抽样人工核验支持了报告中的总体估计，定向复读也比随机复核发现更多不一致。本文作为 Jev 辅助的统计工作流被收录，其有效性依赖抽样与人工核验，测量的是文档记录的因素，而非事故的潜在成因。

papers.title: JevForest: Path Voting for Budgeted Feature Acquisition

summary.en: JevForest uses votes from bootstrapped tree paths to choose which semantic questions Jev should answer under a feature budget. Small AG News and TREC pilots show opposing task-level rankings, while asking all eight questions together is faster, cheaper, and more accurate than four sequential forest queries. It is included as an implemented acquisition workflow whose results distinguish a question budget from actual serving cost and do not establish a general deployment advantage.
summary.zh: JevForest 利用自助采样树路径的投票，在特征预算约束下选择让 Jev 回答哪些语义问题。AG News 和 TREC 的小规模试验给出了相反的任务级方法排名，而将全部八个问题一次提出，比按森林策略顺序询问四个问题更快、更便宜且更准确。本文作为已实现的特征获取工作流被收录，其结果区分了问题数量预算与实际服务成本，尚未确立普遍的部署优势。

papers.title: Probabilistic Sensing, Deterministic Authority: Admitting Model-Produced Observations into Sufficiency-Checked Governance Contracts

summary.en: This framework admits Jev or Claude-produced observations through held-out thresholds before deterministic governance contracts decide whether to authorize an action. A registered study of two constructed domains and 36,000 model calls checks an error bound and finds thirteen deny-to-allow changes among 21,000 test verdicts. It is included as a concrete Jev governance application, with informative but uncalibrated sensor scores and guarantees conditional on the declared contracts and reachable states.
summary.zh: 该框架先通过在留出集上确定的阈值接纳 Jev 或 Claude 生成的观测，再由确定性的治理契约决定是否授权某项操作。一项预注册研究在两个构造领域中开展 36,000 次模型调用，检验误差界，并在 21,000 个测试判定中发现十三次由拒绝变为允许的变化。本文作为具体的 Jev 治理应用被收录；传感评分具有信息价值但未经校准，相关保证也以声明的契约和可达状态为条件。

papers.title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?

summary.en: JevKT uses Jev's typed probabilities to predict learner responses when a platform has little or no interaction history, optionally adding examples and similar-learner statistics. Across seven datasets, it outperforms the evaluated generative and low-data deep knowledge-tracing baselines, while supervised models catch up as logged learners increase. It is included as a direct cold-start education application; the advantage does not extend to every setting, including unseen items with ample learner data.
summary.zh: JevKT 利用 Jev 的类型化概率，在平台几乎没有或完全没有交互历史时预测学习者作答，并可选加入示例和相似学习者统计。在七个数据集上，它优于受评估的生成式基线及低数据量深度知识追踪基线；随着有记录的学习者增加，监督模型逐步追平。本文作为直接的教育冷启动应用被收录，但其优势并不适用于所有情境，包括学习者数据充足时预测未见过的题目。

papers.title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface

summary.en: MetaEncoder adapts a multimodal decoder into a bi-encoder that scores natural-language candidates and returns a probability distribution, supporting both bounded decisions and large retrieval sets. Evaluation spans eleven benchmark suites and 190 tasks, including Jev-format decision tests, image and video understanding, and retrieval. It is included as an explicit System One architecture with a TypeSafe connection, while reasoning-intensive tasks and several retrieval comparisons remain weaknesses.
summary.zh: MetaEncoder 将多模态解码器适配为双编码器，对自然语言候选项评分并返回概率分布，同时支持有限选项决策与大规模检索候选集。评估覆盖十一个基准套件和 190 项任务，包括 Jev 格式决策测试、图像与视频理解及检索。本文作为与 TypeSafe 存在关联的明确 System One 架构被收录，但推理密集型任务和部分检索比较仍是其弱项。

papers.title: FastJEV: Understanding Redundancy for Compact JEV Inference

summary.en: FastJEV combines shared context states, candidate-prefix reuse, and decision-guided layer pruning to reduce redundant computation in OmniJev models without additional training. Across three model sizes and six evaluation sets, selected pruning budgets remove roughly 44-46% of candidate depth while retaining over 93% of average task scores. It is included as a Jev-style inference study; prefix sharing can increase latency, so fewer operations do not guarantee faster execution.
summary.zh: FastJEV 结合共享上下文状态、候选项前缀复用和决策引导的层剪枝，无需额外训练即可减少 OmniJev 模型中的冗余计算。在三个模型规模和六个评估集上，选定的剪枝预算移除了约 44–46% 的候选项计算深度，同时保留超过 93% 的平均任务得分。本文作为 Jev 风格的推理研究被收录；前缀共享可能增加延迟，因此运算量减少并不保证执行更快。

papers.title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models

summary.en: TypedBench uses seven policy-labeled generators and nine suites to test Jev and open decision models on framing, calibration, scaling, selective prediction, and decision cost. Jev follows policies but remains wording-sensitive and underconfident; under asymmetric costs, acting on its probabilities can perform worse than selecting its top answer. It is included for linking probability quality to induced decisions and comparing calibration against a matched finite-sample noise floor.
summary.zh: TypedBench 使用七个按策略生成标签的生成器和九组评测，检验 Jev 及开放决策模型的问题表述、校准、扩展性、选择性预测和决策成本。Jev 能遵循策略，但仍对措辞敏感且置信度偏低；在非对称成本下，依据其概率行动可能比直接选择概率最高的答案更差。本文将概率质量与最终决策相联系，并将校准误差与条件匹配的有限样本噪声基线比较。

papers.title: Adversarial Cues in Decision Models Used as Judges: The Role of Request Presentation

summary.en: This controlled judging study changes a candidate answer with a single punctuation cue while varying how a structured request is presented. On 200 new source clusters, Jev's false acceptance rises sharply under sorted JSON keys but not insertion presentation, despite passing basic controls in both settings. It is included as evidence of integration-sensitive judging failures, with reference-aware constructions, compound ordering changes, and unresolved comparator responses limiting operational conclusions.
summary.zh: 这项受控评判研究在改变结构化请求呈现方式的同时，仅通过一个标点线索修改候选答案。在 200 组新的来源样本上，按键排序的 JSON 请求使 Jev 的错误接受率显著增加，而按插入顺序呈现时没有出现同样现象，尽管两种条件都通过了基本对照。本文揭示依赖集成方式的评判失效，但利用参考答案构造样本、复合顺序变化和未解决的对照模型响应问题限制了实际应用结论。

papers.title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?

summary.en: The authors place a frozen Jev model inside reinforcement learning as a policy reference, exploration judge, or replay rater. Experiments on nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games report improved early learning, including cases where the trained learner outperforms direct Jev control and later acts without it. It is included for testing decision models as training components, with benefits dependent on task representation and with cardinal value estimates outside the supported roles.
summary.zh: 作者将冻结的 Jev 模型引入强化学习，用作策略参考、探索判断器或经验回放评分器。九项 MiniGrid 任务与三个 Atari 游戏的实验报告了早期学习改善，其中部分训练后的学习器超过了直接由 Jev 控制的表现，并能在后续不依赖 Jev 行动。本文检验了将决策模型作为训练组件的用途，因此被收录；收益取决于任务表示，且这些角色并不支持对价值大小的基数估计。

papers.title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs

summary.en: This evaluation compares Jev with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models on English stance detection and Chinese conversational stance. Jev is competitive on VAST but trails stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, with errors concentrated in stance direction and reply relationships rather than simply longer conversations. It is included as a direct multilingual task comparison, whose two datasets do not establish a general language or conversation-understanding ranking.
summary.zh: 这项评测在英语立场检测与中文对话立场任务上，将 Jev 与四个通用 LLM、两个微调模型比较。Jev 在 VAST 上有竞争力，在 ZS-CSD 上则落后于更强的 LLM，错误集中在立场方向和回复关系，并非仅由对话更长造成。本文提供直接的多语言任务比较，但两个数据集不足以建立通用语言能力或对话理解能力的整体排名。

papers.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks

summary.en: The authors compare Jev with nineteen LLMs across thirteen knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual multiple-choice benchmarks. Jev is competitive on knowledge and commonsense, but scores below every comparator on MathQA, exposing a substantial weakness in multistep calculation. It is included as a broad direct benchmark; the model tiers were not all evaluated under one uniform protocol, and probability-based escalation remains future work.
summary.zh: 作者在十三个知识、推理和多语言选择题基准上，将 Jev 与十九个 LLM 比较。Jev 在知识与常识方面具有竞争力，但在 MathQA 上低于所有对照，暴露出多步计算上的明显弱点。本文提供广泛的直接基准比较；不同档位的模型并非全部在统一协议下评估，基于概率的升级处理仍属于未来工作。

papers.title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails

summary.en: This study evaluates open Jev-style decision models and Qwen readouts as agent guardrails, separating unsafe acceptance from unnecessary blocking. Irrelevant context and misleading option names can reverse correct decisions without reducing confidence, while tested defenses fail under adapted attacks. It is included for examining the option channel in independent open models, not hosted Jev; exact deterministic rules succeed where the synthetic policies can be fully parsed into typed fields.
summary.zh: 研究将开放的 Jev 风格决策模型和 Qwen 概率读取方法用作智能体防护，分别衡量不安全放行与不必要阻止。无关上下文和误导性选项名称能够在不降低置信度的情况下翻转正确决策，测试过的防御也会被针对性调整的攻击击败。本文研究的是独立开放模型的选项通道，并非托管 Jev；当合成策略能完整解析为类型化字段时，精确的确定性规则能成功处理这些情况。

papers.title: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows

summary.en: This study integrates Jev into five agents across ALFWorld and AndroidWorld, measuring 4,500 task executions. Decision calls become faster and cheaper, but auxiliary reasoning, extra interactions, failed recovery, and premature completion absorb those savings; two mobile agents lose substantial success, and one agent costs more per successful outcome. It is included as a direct workflow evaluation showing why task delivery and recovery must accompany per-call efficiency measurements.
summary.zh: 研究将 Jev 接入 ALFWorld 和 AndroidWorld 中的五个智能体，评估 4,500 次任务执行。决策调用更快、更便宜，但辅助推理、额外交互、恢复失败和过早结束会抵消收益；两个移动端智能体的成功率明显下降，一个智能体每次成功完成任务的成本反而增加。本文作为直接的工作流评测收录，说明衡量调用效率时还必须关注任务交付与恢复能力。

papers.title: Can Multimodal Decision Models Classify Breast Ultrasound Images? Benchmarking CLEF and CLEF-Flash Across Prompts and Datasets

summary.en: The authors evaluate unchanged CLEF and CLEF-Flash models on 2,818 breast ultrasound images from three datasets under three prompt designs. Clinical instructions improve CLEF-Flash accuracy but reduce CLEF accuracy, and all configurations fall below the majority-class predictor on BUS-BRA. It is included as an application audit of Jev-style multimodal decision models, with dataset shifts, class-specific errors, and prompt sensitivity limiting clinical interpretation.
summary.zh: 作者在三个数据集的 2,818 张乳腺超声图像上，以三种提示设计评估未经调整的 CLEF 与 CLEF-Flash。临床指令提升了 CLEF-Flash 的准确率，却降低了 CLEF 的准确率；在 BUS-BRA 上，所有配置都不及多数类别预测器。本文作为 Jev 风格多模态决策模型的应用审查收录，数据集差异、类别特定错误和提示敏感性限制了其临床解释。

papers.title: Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages

summary.en: This preregistered study evaluates Jev and Laya-multilingual on Indonesian regional-language sentiment and emotion tasks. Human Indonesian translations raise Jev accuracy by up to 37.2 points, while its ability to rank errors deteriorates on regional languages even without higher expected calibration error. Confidence routing can improve the accuracy-cost tradeoff. It is included as a direct multilingual audit that separates language transfer, label budgets, aggregate calibration, and useful uncertainty ranking.
summary.zh: 这项预注册研究在印度尼西亚地方语言的情感与情绪任务上评估 Jev 和 Laya-multilingual。使用人工提供的印度尼西亚语译文，最多使 Jev 准确率提高 37.2 个百分点；即使期望校准误差没有增大，模型在地方语言中识别自身错误的排序能力仍会下降。置信度路由可改善准确率与成本的权衡。本文区分语言迁移、标注预算、整体校准与有用的不确定性排序。

papers.title: DICE: Tilting the Odds through Interface Attackson System One Model

summary.en: DICE studies bounded attacks on state extraction, question generation, and output interpretation in a Jev pipeline. Three small synthetic experiments show that surrounding adapters can redirect final decisions without changing Jev or its authentic responses. Checks tying inputs and outputs to their intended meaning stop the tested interventions but can reject valid decisions. It is included for locating application-level trust failures; the pilot does not estimate their prevalence in deployed software.
summary.zh: DICE 研究 Jev 流程中针对状态提取、问题生成和输出解释的有限攻击。三项小规模合成实验表明，即使不改变 Jev 及其真实响应，外围适配器也能使最终决策偏离任务。将输入输出与预期含义绑定的检查可以阻止已测试的干预，但也可能拒绝有效决策。本文用于定位应用层信任失效；这些试验并不估计问题在已部署软件中的普遍程度。

papers.title: Jevolution: A Framework for Studying Communication and Collective Dynamics in AI Agents

summary.en: Jevolution provides an instrumented predator-prey simulator separating world dynamics, asynchronous inference, controller adapters, and experimental records. A Jev-controlled communication study compares six paired habitat seeds and finds an abundance difference whose interval includes zero. It is included as a research framework with a completed Jev experiment, while distinguishing software checks and a small inconclusive case study from evidence of emergent language, adaptive selection, or ecological validity.
summary.zh: Jevolution 提供带有观测记录机制的捕食者—猎物模拟器，将世界动态、异步推理、控制器适配器和实验记录分开。以 Jev 控制的通信实验比较六组成对栖息地随机种子，种群数量差异的区间包含零。本文因研究框架及已完成的 Jev 实验而收录，同时区分软件检查、小规模未得出明确结论的案例与涌现语言、适应性选择或生态有效性的证据。

papers.title: The Company a Question Keeps: Auditing Open Jev-Style Models for Retrieval

summary.en: This retrieval audit tests seven open Jev-style checkpoints on 276 constructed states from 92 TREC queries, varying requested questions, evidence, and candidate eligibility separately. Nimble changes judgments when the request set expands; diagnostic interventions locate serialization effects in Nimble and Von, while Laya movement disappears at reported precision under FP32. It is included for testing request independence, with model-specific mechanisms and query-level uncertainty preventing a blanket claim about hosted Jev.
summary.zh: 这项检索审查在来自 92 个 TREC 查询的 276 个构造状态上测试七个开放 Jev 风格模型，分别改变请求问题、证据和候选资格。Nimble 会随请求集合扩展而改变判断；诊断干预定位了 Nimble 与 Von 的序列化影响，而 Laya 在 FP32 下的概率变化低于报告精度。本文检验请求独立性，模型特定机制与查询级不确定性不支持将结论直接推广到托管 Jev。

papers.title: Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents

summary.en: This psychometric audit compares fourteen decision models, including Jev, with 47 generative models on a Lithuanian organizational survey. Probability vectors better reproduce aggregate item distributions than rounded answers, yet every decision model forecasts individuals worse than other respondents' answer frequencies. It is included as a direct synthetic-respondent evaluation, with limited profile information and a similarity metric that cannot reliably rank models against a second small human sample constraining interpretation.
summary.zh: 这项心理测量审查在一份立陶宛组织心理学问卷上，比较包括 Jev 在内的十四个决策模型与 47 个生成式模型。概率向量比四舍五入后的答案更能复现整体题目分布，但所有决策模型对个体答案的预测都不如其他受访者的答案频率。本文作为合成受访者直接评测收录；有限的个人资料信息，以及无法可靠比较模型与另一小型真人样本的相似度指标，限制了结论。

papers.title: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models

summary.en: The authors adapt Clef-Flash with quantized LoRA for 24-class symptom-based disease classification, using 960 training and 240 test records. They report 95.42% accuracy and examine symptom sensitivity through leave-one-symptom-out perturbations. It is included as a Jev-style clinical decision-model adaptation, while the small benchmark split, reported serving comparisons, and illustrative perturbation analysis do not establish clinical deployment readiness or causal explanations.
summary.zh: 作者使用量化 LoRA 调整 Clef-Flash，在 960 条训练记录和 240 条测试记录上开展基于症状的 24 类疾病分类。研究报告 95.42% 的准确率，并通过逐一移除症状的扰动分析模型敏感性。本文作为 Jev 风格临床决策模型的适配研究收录；小型基准划分、报告中的服务性能比较和示例性扰动分析，尚不能证明临床部署条件或因果解释。

papers.title: Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers

summary.en: LDMs adapt language models to score runtime-defined labels in one prefill pass using diverse decision supervision and reasoning-distribution distillation. DecisionVista tests novel schemas and held-out human-labeled sources, finding modest transfer improvements and substantial measured speedups over reasoning rollouts. It is included as a Jev-style training and evaluation framework; reasoning still performs better on new schemas, and the reported confidence-routing recovery is measured on development sets.
summary.zh: LDMs 通过多样化决策监督与推理分布蒸馏，使语言模型在一次预填充中对运行时定义的标签评分。DecisionVista 测试新模式及留出的人工标注来源，发现迁移表现适度改善，相较推理生成有明显的实测加速。本文作为 Jev 风格训练与评估框架收录；推理在新模式上仍更强，所报告的置信度路由收益是在开发集上测得的。

papers.title: Poisoned into Action: Context Attacks on Typed Decision Workflows

summary.en: This execution-aware poisoning study traces retrieved context through Jev choices to persisted state across two synthetic workflows and 1,659 fresh calls. Source-exclusion defenses prevent some violations but also withhold legitimate automation, while correct evidence helps in both attack and neutral conditions. It is included for measuring downstream consequences and defense costs together; three prespecified contrasts lack significance after multiple-testing correction, so the findings remain exploratory.
summary.zh: 这项面向执行结果的投毒研究在两个合成工作流与 1,659 次新调用中，追踪检索上下文如何经过 Jev 选择影响持久化状态。来源排除防御阻止了部分违规，却也抑制正常自动化；正确证据在攻击与中性条件下均有帮助。本文同时衡量下游后果与防御成本；三项预先指定的比较在多重检验校正后不显著，因此结果仍属探索性。

papers.title: Suggested Is Not Superseded: A Pre-Registered Evaluation of a System-One Model as a Memory-Retirement Gate

summary.en: The authors test Jev as an assistant-memory retirement gate on 500 relabeled STALE pairs, distinguishing established changes from suggestions. A three-way decision reduces premature retirement but exceeds the preregistered detection-loss budget, and a development-selected reasoning cascade does not beat threshold adjustment on a held-out vault. It is included for examining destructive memory decisions, annotation disagreement, and small-sample selection rather than assuming confidence routing reliably improves the gate.
summary.zh: 作者重新标注 500 组 STALE 配对，区分已确认变化与仅有暗示的变化，测试 Jev 作为助手记忆失效判定门控。三分类决策减少了过早淘汰，但检测损失超过预注册预算；在开发集上选出的推理级联，也未在留出记忆库上优于阈值调整。本文审查具有删除后果的记忆决策、标注分歧与小样本选择问题，不预设置信度路由必然改善门控。

papers.title: RSAJEV: Training-Free Abstaining Prototype Memory for Eliminating Silent Hallucination in JEV-Based Remote Sensing Classification

summary.en: RSAJEV replaces a remote-sensing decision model's letter-token readout with cached image prototypes and a geometric correction, without gradient updates. Cross-dataset tests expose unstable label binding and overconfidence on unseen classes; prototype scores improve classification and open-set discrimination across the evaluated datasets. It is included as a Jev-style visual readout and abstention method, with its gains dependent on available class references and the tested dataset transfers rather than eliminating all hallucinations.
summary.zh: RSAJEV 用缓存图像原型及几何校正替换遥感决策模型的字母标记读出，无需梯度更新。跨数据集测试暴露了不稳定的标签绑定及对未见类别的过度自信；原型分数改善了已评估数据集中的分类与开放集辨别。本文作为 Jev 风格视觉读出与弃答方法收录，其收益依赖可用类别参考和已测试的数据迁移，并不意味着消除所有幻觉。

papers.title: Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces

summary.en: Choice2Seq compares selecting a complete answer with constructing it through local decisions on matched problems. Jev retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of its correct arithmetic and lexical selections under serial construction, while candidate-supported options and position cues partially repair different failures. It is included as an interface-composition benchmark separating correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance; dialogue-state results show that the gap depends on both model and task.
summary.zh: Choice2Seq 在匹配的问题上比较完整答案选择与局部决策逐步构造。Jev 在串行构造中仅保留算术与词汇检索正确选择的 33.0% 和 2.1%；由候选答案支持的选项和位置提示可部分修复不同失效。本文作为接口组合基准收录，区分正确性、计划忠实度和输出合规性；对话状态结果说明差距同时取决于模型与任务。

papers.title: Embodied Skill Bench: Benchmarking How Well Agents with Embodied Skills Perform on Physical Tasks

summary.en: EmbodiedSkillBench packages 250 embodied skills and compares native control, skill-only execution, and selective reuse on 100 perturbed LIBERO-Pro tasks. Skills help weaker agents but constrain a stronger agent; using Jev to select motion and gripper actions cuts that agent's tokens and time while lowering success from its native baseline. It is included for explicitly measuring Jev within embodied skill reuse and preserving the success-efficiency tradeoff.
summary.zh: EmbodiedSkillBench 整理 250 项具身技能，在 100 个扰动后的 LIBERO-Pro 任务上比较原生控制、仅技能执行和选择性复用。技能帮助较弱智能体，却限制了更强智能体；使用 Jev 选择运动方向与夹爪动作减少了后者的标记消耗和时间，但成功率低于原生基线。本文明确测量 Jev 在具身技能复用中的表现，并保留成功率与效率的权衡。

papers.title: CT0: Cybersecurity Transformer

summary.en: CT0 combines a Jev-inspired typed-decision head and a generative security agent within one specialized backbone, routing uncertain cases to generation. The authors report improvements in file screening, refusal detection, jailbreak classification, and vulnerability-fact extraction using a compact model. It is included as a domain-specific extension of the decision interface, with author-run security benchmarks, workload-specific metrics, and the distinction between classification and agent performance limiting general claims.
summary.zh: CT0 在同一专门化骨干中结合受 Jev 启发的类型化决策头与生成式安全智能体，将不确定案例路由到生成路径。作者报告紧凑模型在文件筛查、拒答检测、越狱分类和漏洞事实提取上的改善。本文作为决策接口的领域专门化扩展收录；作者自行运行的安全基准、依赖工作负载的指标，以及分类与智能体表现的区别，限制了普遍性结论。

papers.title: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev

summary.en: This preregistered audit uses 299,463 Jev calls to test whether irrelevant alternatives preserve odds between leading labels. Added options systematically change those odds, with larger candidate sets amplifying distortion, whereas separately packed questions show negligible interaction. Independent binary scoring removes option-set dependence but loses accuracy. It is included as a direct probability-semantics study showing that Jev probabilities are conditional on the offered option set rather than intrinsic properties of individual labels.
summary.zh: 这项预注册审查通过 299,463 次 Jev 调用，检验无关备选项是否保持领先标签之间的赔率。新增选项会系统性改变赔率，候选集合越大，扭曲越明显，而同一调用中分开打包的问题几乎没有交互。独立二元评分消除了选项集合依赖，却损失准确率。本文直接研究概率语义，表明 Jev 概率以给定选项集合为条件，并非各标签的固有属性。

papers.title: Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention

summary.en: ProAgent couples StreamingJev, a Jev-style intervention-timing model, with a response model that communicates or invokes physical devices. Video-derived supervision trains the system to detect emerging needs under explicit goals or standing roles, and real-robot experiments test physical responses. It is included as a proactive embodied decision architecture, with reported timing and false-trigger improvements tied to its evaluated objectives, backbone comparisons, and robot settings.
summary.zh: ProAgent 将 Jev 风格干预时机模型 StreamingJev 与负责交流或调用物理设备的响应模型结合。系统利用从视频生成的监督数据，在明确目标或持续角色要求下识别新出现的需求，并通过真实机器人实验测试物理响应。本文作为主动式具身决策架构收录，所报告的时机判断与误触发改善仍取决于已评估目标、骨干比较和机器人设置。

papers.title: ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty

summary.en: ProbabilityBench constructs three simulated text domains with analytically known class probabilities and Bayes error, enabling direct evaluation of uncertainty and calibration estimators. Across sixteen models, decision systems including Jev appear frequently on the observed cost-quality frontier. It is included as a direct probability-quality benchmark, while its exact uncertainty comes from specified synthetic generators and probability-preserving text rendering, not from naturally observed ambiguity in real-world data.
summary.zh: ProbabilityBench 构建三个类别概率与贝叶斯误差可解析计算的模拟文本领域，用于直接评估不确定性及校准估计方法。在十六个模型中，包括 Jev 在内的决策系统经常位于观测到的成本—质量前沿。本文作为直接的概率质量基准收录；其精确不确定性来自指定的合成生成过程及保持概率的文本转换，而非真实数据中自然产生的模糊性。

papers.title: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction

summary.en: CalOn jointly encodes text and user-specified types for entity, relation, and event extraction, using a null class and explicit probability distributions. Its training adds a sampled-decision reward explicitly inspired by TypeSafe's RLCD framing, and evaluation covers forty benchmarks. It is included as an interface-level extension to structured extraction; it neither evaluates hosted Jev nor reproduces proprietary RLCD, and its confidence correction must be assessed separately from extraction F1.
summary.zh: CalOn 联合编码文本与用户指定类型，以空类别和显式概率分布完成实体、关系及事件提取。其训练加入明确受 TypeSafe RLCD 思路启发的采样决策奖励，并在四十个基准上评估。本文作为类型化接口向结构化提取的扩展收录；它既未评估托管 Jev，也未复现专有 RLCD，置信度校正的效果需要与提取 F1 分开判断。

papers.title: FunDM: Cheap & Label-Free Decision Models from Frozen Language Models

summary.en: FunDM trains small decision heads to imitate a frozen language model's answer probabilities without correct-answer labels, using only part of the backbone. A Qwen3-8B variant retains nearly all of its full model's average multiple-choice accuracy while improving measured throughput and memory use; separately trained heads select coding-agent runs. It is included as a Jev-style distillation approach, with efficiency and selection results conditional on the chosen teacher, tasks, and serving setup.
summary.zh: FunDM 无需正确答案标签，训练小型决策头模仿冻结语言模型的答案概率，并仅使用部分骨干层。一个 Qwen3-8B 变体保留了完整模型几乎全部的平均多项选择准确率，同时改善实测吞吐量和内存占用；另行训练的决策头用于选择编程智能体运行结果。本文作为 Jev 风格蒸馏方法收录，效率与选择表现依赖教师模型、任务和服务配置。

papers.title: Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models

summary.en: The authors compare letter-logit readouts and simple LoRA decision-head tuning across four open language models against Jev. Their OpenDecisions validation set combines accuracy and calibration, and tuned Gemma improves on Jev there and on JevBench. It is included as an explicit reproduction and baseline comparison, distinguishing strong untuned readouts from additional tuning gains and avoiding generalization of author-reported benchmark advantages to all decision workloads.
summary.zh: 作者在四个开放语言模型上比较字母 logit 读出与简单的 LoRA 决策头微调，并与 Jev 对照。其 OpenDecisions 验证集结合准确率与校准，微调后的 Gemma 在该数据集和 JevBench 上均优于 Jev。本文作为明确的复现及基线比较收录，区分未经训练读出的能力与额外微调收益，不将作者报告的基准优势推广到所有决策工作负载。

papers.title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions

summary.en: StartLux-Decision pairs single-pass Instant models with AutoThink variants that invoke reasoning for uncertain cases. Its RLCD² method rewards improved probability quality and penalizes long reasoning, reporting shorter traces and stronger results on public Decision Index subsets and computational contrast pairs. It is included as an independent Jev-style training framework with explicit Jev comparisons; RLCD² is the authors' disclosed method, not a disclosure of TypeSafe's proprietary RLCD.
summary.zh: StartLux-Decision 同时提供单次前向的 Instant 模型与对不确定案例启动推理的 AutoThink 变体。其 RLCD² 方法奖励概率质量改善并惩罚过长推理，报告了更短推理轨迹及在公开 Decision Index 子集和计算对比样本上的更强表现。本文作为独立 Jev 风格训练框架收录，包含明确的 Jev 比较；RLCD² 是作者公开的方法，并非 TypeSafe 专有 RLCD 的披露。

papers.title: SkillScreen: High-Recall Screening of Malicious Agent Skills with Decision Models

summary.en: SkillScreen fine-tunes OpenJev-2B to score malicious agent-skill instructions and compares with hosted Jev, classifiers, and prompted judges. On unseen attack families, it flags 20–25% of benign skills at 99% recall, improving the evaluated review-load tradeoff. It is included as a direct decision-model security comparison, while unfamiliar benign sources sharply increase false positives and prevent treating attack-family generalization as reliable screening across arbitrary skill collections.
summary.zh: SkillScreen 微调 OpenJev-2B，对恶意智能体技能指令评分，并与托管 Jev、分类器及提示式评判模型比较。在未见攻击家族上，99% 召回率对应 20–25% 的正常技能误报，改善了所评估的审核负担权衡。本文作为直接的决策模型安全比较收录，但陌生正常来源显著增加误报，因此对攻击家族的泛化不等于对任意技能集合的可靠筛查。

papers.title: Same Attack, Different Judge: A First Controlled Adversarial Comparison of Jev, LLM Judges, and Purpose-Built Safety Classifiers

summary.en: This controlled study sends identical adversarial payloads and policies to Jev, five LLM judges, and two safety classifiers across four tasks. Jev resists several input-moderation attacks but remains vulnerable in phishing judgment, where its clean recall is also lower; it is fast but flags many benign requests. It is included for comparing task-dependent robustness under a shared harness, rather than equating typed outputs or one strong moderation result with general security.
summary.zh: 这项受控研究在四项任务上，向 Jev、五个 LLM 评判模型和两个安全分类器提供相同攻击载荷与策略。Jev 抵抗了多种输入审核攻击，但在钓鱼判断中仍有脆弱性，且无攻击时的召回率也较低；它速度快，却会标记较多正常请求。本文在共享测试框架下比较依赖任务的鲁棒性，不将类型化输出或某项审核优势等同于普遍安全。

papers.title: Cheap, Consistent, Calibrated, but Biased? Typed Decision Models as Judges

summary.en: The authors apply CALM bias tests to eight typed decision models, including Jev, and seven LLM judges. Every typed model exhibits several biases, with emotional rewrites and answer order affecting judgments despite comparatively consistent, inexpensive outputs. It is included as a direct judge evaluation showing that calibration does not remove bias; correlated failures across judge types and task-specific sensitivities limit the case for replacing generative judges solely on cost grounds.
summary.zh: 作者将 CALM 偏差测试用于包括 Jev 在内的八个类型化决策模型与七个 LLM 评判模型。每个类型化模型都表现出多种偏差，情绪化改写和答案顺序会影响判断，尽管输出相对一致且成本较低。本文作为直接评判模型评测收录，说明校准不能消除偏差；不同评判类型的相关失误和任务敏感性限制了仅凭成本替代生成式评判模型的理由。

papers.title: Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models

summary.en: Runoff first scores options independently, then compares a short list across balanced candidate positions to make Jev-style choices invariant to option order. Experiments on open readouts and eight System One models report no shuffled-answer changes, while cyclic averaging retains order sensitivity. It is included as a training-free reliability method, distinguishing guaranteed order invariance from task accuracy and tying reported speed advantages to the tested candidate counts and implementations.
summary.zh: Runoff 先独立评分各选项，再让短名单候选在均衡位置上比较，使 Jev 风格选择不依赖选项顺序。在开放读出与八个 System One 模型上的实验报告打乱顺序后答案不变，而循环平均仍有顺序敏感性。本文作为无需训练的可靠性方法收录，区分可保证的顺序不变性与任务准确率，并将加速结论限定于已测试的候选规模和实现。

papers.title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research

summary.en: JevGPT combines deliberative research planning with parallel, fast judgments of source relevance and evidence support. Selected original passages feed subsequent research steps, and fixed-corpus question-answering and ranking experiments report broader evidence coverage with competitive performance and lower time and cost. It is included as a Jev-based research-agent architecture, with results bounded by the evaluated corpora and comparators rather than proving reliability across unrestricted open-web research.
summary.zh: JevGPT 将审慎的研究规划与并行、快速的来源相关性和证据支持判断结合。筛选后的原文段落进入后续研究步骤；固定语料问答与排序实验报告更广的证据覆盖、具竞争力的表现及更低时间与成本。本文作为基于 Jev 的研究智能体架构收录，结果受已评估语料与对照系统约束，不能证明在无限制开放网络研究中的可靠性。

papers.title: Jev-Guard: Fast Routing and Auditing Agent Actions over Editable Policy Trees

summary.en: Jev-Guard routes audit contexts through editable policy trees before making policy-conditioned safety decisions. The authors report 93.72% classification accuracy on 7,033 cases, separating 58 ms classification latency from a 240 ms full pipeline, and test a permission gate inside Hermes. It is included as a Jev-style safety architecture; no observed violations in the tested trajectories is limited evidence, and routing, classification, and end-to-end review costs must remain distinct.
summary.zh: Jev-Guard 先在可编辑策略树中路由审核上下文，再依据选中策略作出安全决策。作者在 7,033 个案例上报告 93.72% 分类准确率，区分 58 毫秒分类延迟与 240 毫秒完整流程，并在 Hermes 中测试权限门控。本文作为 Jev 风格安全架构收录；已测试轨迹中未观察到违规仅提供有限证据，路由、分类与端到端审核成本应分别解释。

papers.title: PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes

summary.en: PRISM perturbs evaluative emphasis while keeping judged content fixed, then learns a correction from human labels using the resulting score sensitivities. Jev and Sol experiments on SummEval and HANNA improve agreement with human rankings and test quality-based versus style-based probes. It is included as a direct Jev-judge calibration method, whose supervised corrections and dataset-specific agreement gains do not establish unbiased judgments or transfer without local validation.
summary.zh: PRISM 保持被评内容不变，改变评价侧重点，再根据分数敏感性及人工标签学习校正。在 SummEval 和 HANNA 上，Jev 与 Sol 的实验改善了与人工排序的一致性，并比较质量与风格探针。本文作为直接面向 Jev 评判模型的校准方法收录；有监督校正和特定数据集上的一致性收益，并不能证明判断无偏或无需本地验证即可迁移。

papers.title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments

summary.en: This tool-call audit compares seven judges, including Jev and CLM, and finds that correct arguments are less often accepted when their supporting reference is absent or must be derived. Controlled source relocation shows preference for visible incorrect values over unsupported correct ones. DeRef supplies candidate-blind references from full history and improves AUROC. It is included for examining evidence availability in agent verification, with benchmark gains distinct from universal tool-use correctness.
summary.zh: 这项工具调用审查比较包括 Jev 和 CLM 在内的七个评判模型，发现当支持依据缺失或需要推导时，正确参数更少被接受。受控的来源位置调整表明，模型偏好可见的错误值，而非缺少依据的正确值。DeRef 在不查看候选答案的条件下从完整历史生成参考，提高了 AUROC。本文研究智能体验证中的证据可用性，区分基准收益与普遍的工具使用正确性。

papers.title: How Reliable Are System-One Decisions in Medicine? A Comparative Study of Jev, Jev-like Models, and LLMs

summary.en: This study compares Jev, open decision models, and LLMs on 8,742 instances from fifteen medical datasets, testing accuracy, framing stability, and abstention. Jev is competitive on text-driven tasks and stable under formatting changes but weaker on numerical tasks and missing-answer detection. Independent binary scoring improves retained accuracy. It is included as a broad medical reliability audit, keeping decision consistency separate from safe abstention and clinical competence.
summary.zh: 这项研究在十五个医学数据集的 8,742 个样本上比较 Jev、开放决策模型与 LLM，测试准确率、表述稳定性和弃答。Jev 在文本驱动任务上有竞争力，对格式变化也较稳定，但数值任务和正确答案缺失检测较弱。独立二元评分改善了保留答案的准确率。本文作为广泛的医学可靠性审查收录，将决策一致性与安全弃答、临床能力分开。

papers.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops

summary.en: The authors pair next-action decisions with independent factual probes across frozen agent states, comparing seventeen fast systems, including Jev, and a reasoning model. Many wrong actions follow correct probe answers; code composition repairs failures when probes determine the action, while supplying subgoals helps on real states. It is included as a behavioral diagnosis of agent decisions, with causal attribution limited by whether the probes actually contain sufficient evidence.
summary.zh: 作者在冻结的智能体状态上，将下一步动作决策与独立事实探针配对，比较包括 Jev 在内的十七个快速系统及一个推理模型。许多错误动作出现在探针全部答对之后；当探针足以决定动作时，代码组合可修复失效，而真实状态中提供子目标更有帮助。本文作为智能体决策的行为诊断收录，因果归因取决于探针是否真正包含充分证据。

papers.title: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models

summary.en: Jev-ToM evaluates five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English theory-of-mind questions from nine benchmarks. Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy and performs strongly across capability groups, but confidence selection, attached reasons, and expanded candidate sets have task-dependent effects. It is included as a direct social-reasoning evaluation, with benchmark selection and separate resource measurements limiting claims about collaborative assistants in deployment.
summary.zh: Jev-ToM 在九个基准的 11,117 道英语心智理论题目上评估五个类型化决策模型与七个生成式基线。Jev 的来源均衡准确率达到 73.2%，在多个能力组中表现较强，但置信度选择、附加理由和候选扩展的效果依赖任务。本文作为直接的社会推理评测收录，基准选择与单独测量的资源数据限制了对已部署协作助手的推断。

papers.title: Nudge the Judge: Uncovering Program Decision Hijacking in Real-World Jev Applications

summary.en: JevProbe traces attacker-controlled context through schema-valid Jev judgments to downstream application decisions in 228 applications and 2,273 test cases. The authors report decision flips in 81.5% of cases and potential security consequences for most flips, with limited protection from tested defenses. It is included as an application-grounded security evaluation, distinguishing reachable attack surfaces and potential consequences from confirmed exploitation or measured incidents in production.
summary.zh: JevProbe 在 228 个应用与 2,273 个测试案例中，追踪攻击者控制的上下文如何经过符合模式的 Jev 判断影响下游决策。作者报告 81.5% 的案例发生决策翻转，多数翻转具有潜在安全后果，已测试防御的保护有限。本文作为以应用为基础的安全评测收录，区分可达攻击面、潜在后果与已确认利用或生产事故。

papers.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction

summary.en: VideoJev replaces autoregressive answers with shared scoring of temporal intervals and text options against video evidence, supporting cached and joint queries. Two model sizes improve temporal grounding over their backbones and match thinking-mode video-question accuracy with large measured speedups. It is included as a Jev-style multimodal decision architecture, with gains tied to the tested grounding and multiple-choice benchmarks rather than unrestricted video understanding or autonomous interaction.
summary.zh: VideoJev 用对视频证据下时间区间与文本选项的共享评分替代自回归回答，支持缓存查询与联合查询。两种规模的模型改善了相对骨干的时间定位，并在保持接近思考模式的视频问答准确率时获得显著实测加速。本文作为 Jev 风格多模态决策架构收录，收益限定于所测试的定位及多项选择基准，而非无限制的视频理解或自主交互。

papers.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles

summary.en: Jeva independently encodes requests and reusable options, refining request states against fixed option memory while separately estimating answer coverage. This design supports typed outputs, candidate permutations, null outcomes, and large option sets. It is included as a decision-native alternative in the Jev research line, with reported permutation stability and caching gains distinguished from universal calibration or reliable answer-absence detection outside the evaluated distributions.
summary.zh: Jeva 独立编码请求与可复用选项，依据固定选项记忆细化请求状态，并单独估计答案覆盖情况。该设计支持类型化输出、候选重排、空结果及大规模选项集合。本文作为 Jev 研究方向中的原生决策替代架构收录，区分报告中的重排稳定性、缓存收益与在评估分布之外的普遍校准或可靠缺失答案检测。

papers.title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

summary.en: BLADE uses Jev probabilities to select information handoffs for auditing in failed multi-agent runs, distinguishing introduced errors, propagated errors, and repairs. On 1,228 failed runs, it improves step-level attribution over an all-at-once strategy under a shared Jev interface without reference answers. It is included as a concrete Jev-based diagnostic workflow, with attribution accuracy on recorded failures distinct from evidence that the method prevents failures during live execution.
summary.zh: BLADE 使用 Jev 概率选择失败多智能体运行中的信息交接点进行审查，区分错误引入、传播和修复。在 1,228 次失败运行上，它在共享 Jev 接口、无需参考答案的条件下，相对一次性整体判断改善了步骤级归因。本文作为具体的 Jev 诊断工作流收录，区分已记录失败上的归因准确率与防止实时执行失败的证据。

papers.title: WaterSheep 0.1.0: Typed Decisions with Calibrated Probabilities from a Single Encoder Pass

summary.en: WaterSheep fine-tunes ModernBERT with a decision head and question-type temperature scaling for Noul, Choice, Score, and multi-label probabilities. The author's project documentation reports 77.8% in-distribution accuracy and 61.2% on held-out datasets, with ECE of 0.026 and 0.043. It is included as an open Jev-style model with a compatible API; English-only support, input truncation, and weaker rating performance limit its use. The DOI verifies preprint metadata; this summary relies on project documentation because the paper's full text was inaccessible.
summary.zh: WaterSheep 在 ModernBERT 上微调决策头，并按问题类型进行温度缩放，为 Noul、Choice、Score 和多标签任务输出概率。作者项目说明报告分布内准确率为 77.8%，留出数据集准确率为 61.2%，对应 ECE 为 0.026 和 0.043。本文作为开放的 Jev 风格模型被收录，并提供兼容接口；仅支持英语、长输入截断和评分任务表现较弱限制了其用途。DOI 已确认预印本元数据；由于论文全文无法访问，本摘要依据作者项目说明整理。

method.date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date in UTC; verified publication date otherwise
method.unit: One included academic work in one primary domain
method.excluded: Technical sources are excluded from charts; undated papers are excluded from time-series only
method.coverage: Current curated snapshot; recent dates may be incomplete due to announcement and indexing lag
